shell_commands.command: pwd && ls -d /testbed 2>/dev/null; ls -a | head; if [ -f /opt/peeky/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md ]; then cat /opt/peeky/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md; fi
cd /testbed && git --no-pager status --short && rg -n 'ACLLoad|aclLoad|ACL LOAD|acl load' src/acl.c tests/unit/*acl* tests/unit/*repl*

cd /testbed && grep -nE 'ACLLoad|aclLoad|ACL LOAD|acl load|clients' src/acl.c | tail -75 && find tests -iname '*acl*' -o -iname '*repl*' && command -v apply_patch && sed -n '1,100p' tests/unit/acl.tcl
cd /testbed && sed -n '410,520p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2190,2415p' src/acl.c && sed -n '2910,2945p' src/acl.c

cd /testbed && grep -nE 'LOAD|load|replica|primary|master|aclfile' tests/unit/acl.tcl && sed -n '1,140p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && grep -nE '->user =|cached_master|CLIENT_MASTER' src/networking.c src/replication.c | head -90; ls /usr/local/bin/*patch* /usr/bin/*patch* 2>/dev/null
cd /testbed && grep -nE -- '->user =|cached_master|flag.master' src/networking.c src/replication.c | head -110 && sed -n '1915,1990p' src/acl.c && sed -n '950,1130p' tests/unit/acl.tcl

cd /testbed && sed -n '300,410p' tests/unit/acl.tcl && sed -n '1,160p' tests/integration/replication.tcl && grep -nE 'wait_for_sync|wait_for_ofs_sync|master_link_status|slaveof|replicaof' tests/unit/acl-v2.tcl tests/support/util.tcl tests/unit/auth.tcl && sed -n '1,100p' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp.md && grep -nE 'background|--until|attach|drain' /opt/peeky/docs/lang/c-cpp-cookbook.md | head -30

cd /testbed && sed -n '1970,2015p' src/replication.c && grep -n -A38 -B8 'ACLCheckAllPerm' src/acl.c src/server.c && sed -n '100,142p' tests/support/util.tcl && sed -n '45,98p' tests/unit/auth.tcl && cat tests/assets/user.acl && sed -n '1,90p' runtest

cd /testbed && find . -name '*patch*' -maxdepth 3 | head && ls -l src/valkey-server && grep -nE 'test.*tags|proc test|--only' tests/test_helper.tcl tests/support/test.tcl | head -65 && git --no-pager log -1 --oneline

cd /testbed && git apply <<'PATCH'
diff --git a/tests/unit/acl.tcl b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1118,6 +1118,38 @@
 
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
 exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
+start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "nodefaultuser.acl"] tags [list "acl" "repl" "external:skip"]] {
+    set replica [srv 0 client]
+    start_server {} {
+        set primary [srv 0 client]
+
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica updates users without disrupting replication} {
+            $replica replicaof [srv 0 host] [srv 0 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            $replica ACL SETUSER alice reset on >temporary +ping +acl
+            assert_equal OK [$replica AUTH alice temporary]
+            assert_error {*NOPERM*get*} {$replica GET acl-replication-key}
+
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal OK [$replica AUTH alice alice]
+            assert_error {*WRONGPASS*} {$replica AUTH alice temporary}
+
+            # The primary connection must remain exempt from the replica's ACLs.
+            $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+            $primary SET acl-replication-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal value [$replica GET acl-replication-key]
+            assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
 exec cp -f tests/assets/default.conf $server_path
 start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "nodefaultuser.acl"] tags [list "external:skip"]] {
 
PATCH
./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica updates users without disrupting replication'

cd /testbed && git apply --recount <<'PATCH'
diff --git a/tests/unit/acl.tcl b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1118,3 +1118,32 @@
 
+set server_path [tmpdir "replica.acl"]
+exec cp -f tests/assets/user.acl $server_path
+start_server [list overrides [list "dir" $server_path "aclfile" "user.acl"] tags [list "acl" "repl" "external:skip"]] {
+    set replica [srv 0 client]
+    start_server {} {
+        set primary [srv 0 client]
+
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica updates users without disrupting replication} {
+            $replica replicaof [srv 0 host] [srv 0 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            $replica ACL SETUSER alice reset on >temporary +ping +acl
+            assert_equal OK [$replica AUTH alice temporary]
+            assert_error {*NOPERM*get*} {$replica GET acl-replication-key}
+
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal OK [$replica AUTH alice alice]
+            assert_error {*WRONGPASS*} {$replica AUTH alice temporary}
+
+            # The primary connection must remain exempt from the replica's ACLs.
+            $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+            $primary SET acl-replication-key value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal value [$replica GET acl-replication-key]
+            assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+        }
+    }
+}
+
 set server_path [tmpdir "resetchannels.acl"]
 exec cp -f tests/assets/nodefaultuser.acl $server_path
PATCH
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
./runtest --single unit/acl --only 'ACL LOAD on a replica updates users without disrupting replication' > /tmp/valkey-acl-load-baseline.log 2>&1
result=$?
grep -nE 'fail|crash|signal|acl.c|ACLLoad|FAIL|passed|updates users' /tmp/valkey-acl-load-baseline.log | head -40
tail -12 /tmp/valkey-acl-load-baseline.log
exit "$result"

cd /testbed && ./runtest --single unit/acl --single unit/acl-v2 > /tmp/valkey-acl-load-suites.log 2>&1
result=$?
tail -22 /tmp/valkey-acl-load-suites.log
exit "$result"

cd /testbed && git diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager diff -- src/acl.c tests/unit/acl.tcl && git --no-pager status --short && grep -nE 'warning:|error:' /tmp/valkey-acl-load-build.log | head -15
rm /tmp/valkey-acl-load-baseline.log /tmp/valkey-acl-load-build.log /tmp/valkey-acl-load-fixed.log /tmp/valkey-acl-load-suites.log && cd /testbed && git diff --check && git --no-pager status --short
